B/MD C4 Pack.procurement: The B/MD C4 Pack is unlocked on the 3rd page of the Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond for 110 Medals.

SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun.procurement: The SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun is one of few support weapons not available for acquisition or deployment for Helldivers, as it is designed for civilian use and non-combatant applications. However, they can be found near human corpses on the following Minor Places of Interest: Graves Elevated House

CQC-72 Entrenchment Tool.procurement: Much like the SG-88 Break-Action Shotgun, The CQC-72 Entenchment tool can be found in various points of interest during missions, most often within Minor Places of Interest such as Bunkers, Destroyed Houses, Graves, and especially at the Burial Grounds. Graves House Crashed Ship Bunker A secondary weapon variant, the CQC-73 Entrenchment Tool, is unlocked on the 1st page of the Entrenched Division
